title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Modified Omega Bio-Tek E.Z.N.A.
author: Amy Denton

steps.title: Prepare sample tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and label tubes based on the disruption method used for the samples.

substeps.instruction: For samples requiring powermashing: label 1.5 mL BioMasher tubes and corresponding sterile BioMasher pestles.
For cryogenically disrupted samples (e.g., bead beating): label 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Transfer samples into the corresponding tubes.

steps.title: Lysis and homogenization
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagents and homogenize samples according to their type.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μL of ML1 buffer and 25 μL Proteinase K solution to all samples.
For powermashing samples: use the BioMasher pestle and Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor following the Sanger Tree of Life Sample Homogenisation: PowerMash protocol.
For cryogenically disrupted samples: pipette-mix gently 10 times using a wide-bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at 60 °C for at least 30 minutes; extend to 45 minutes or 1 hour if samples are not completely solubilized.

steps.title: Transfer to microcentrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer samples from 1.5 mL BioMasher tubes to fresh, labeled 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes using a wide-bore pipette. Samples already in 2 mL tubes do not need transfer.

steps.title: Chloroform separation
steps.instruction: Perform phase separation in a fume hood to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μL of chloroform:isoamyl (24:1) to each sample in the fume hood.
Rotate samples on a HulaMixer™ at 8 rpm for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 10,000 g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip in the fume hood, transfer the upper aqueous phase (containing gDNA) to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the milky interphase.

steps.title: DNA precipitation and RNA removal
steps.instruction: Prepare the aqueous phase for bead-based extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 X volume of BL buffer to each sample (e.g., 400 μL BL buffer for 400 μL of aqueous phase).
Add 10 μL RNase A to each sample and pipette-mix 15 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Incubate samples for 10 minutes at 70 °C.
Remove from heat block and cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher™ plates
steps.instruction: Label and fill five 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates as follows:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Tip Plate): 96-well tip comb (no reagents).
Plate 2 (Sample Plate): ~500 μL sample + ~500 μL SpeedBead solution.
Plate 3 (Ethanol Wash 1): 1 mL freshly prepared 80% EtOH.
Plate 4 (Ethanol Wash 2): 1 mL freshly prepared 80% EtOH.
Plate 5 (Elution Plate): 400 μL buffer EB.

steps.title: Load samples into Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate to the sample plate and add beads.

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 600 µL, transfer lysate from room temperature tubes into the sample plate, avoiding large debris (actual volume varies 500–600 µL).
Vortex Sera-Mag™ SpeedBead solution and add 400–500 μL to each sample.
Ensure total volume (sample + SpeedBead solution) does not exceed 1 mL (e.g., for 600 μL sample, add only 400 μL beads).

steps.title: Automated DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Run the DNA extraction protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex.

substeps.instruction: Select the required DNA extraction protocol and press play.
Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 90 minutes).
Remove plates following on-screen instructions.

steps.title: Recover purified gDNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the 400 μL EB buffer containing purified gDNA from the Elution plate into new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes using a wide-bore pipette tip (or keep in Elution plate if proceeding to 0.45X SPRI).

steps.title: Prepare 0.45X SPRI plates
steps.instruction: Set up KingFisher™ plates for 0.45X SPRI cleanup:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Tip Plate): 1 mL Deep-well 96-well tip comb (no reagent).
Plate 2 (Sample Plate): 1 mL Deep-well containing 400 µL DNA + 180 µL AMPure PB beads.
Plate 3 (Ethanol Wash Plate): 1 mL Deep-well containing 1 mL 80% EtOH (freshly made).
Plate 4 (Elution Plate): 200 µL standard containing 135 µL Buffer EB.

steps.title: Automated 0.45X SPRI cleanup
steps.instruction: Run the 0.45X SPRI protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex.

substeps.instruction: Select the 0.45X SPRI protocol and press play.
Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 45 minutes).
Remove plates following on-screen instructions.

steps.title: Final recovery and storage
steps.instruction: Recover the final DNA eluate and store.

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into new microcentrifuge tubes.
Incubate DNA at room temperature overnight.
Perform QC the following morning.
Store DNA at 4 °C.
